description: In an age of information overload, stories can rise above the noise. Effective organizational storytelling helps to engage an intended community on a meaningful and emotional level. Students will explore the craft of storytelling and study a variety of media (analogue and digital) on which the story can be delivered. The course will include case study analysis, group work and client-based projects. Offered annually. Prerequisite: sophomore status or above.
name: Organizational Storytelling
notes: Not open to incoming first-year students.
This course includes an academic civic engagement (ACE) component.
